en: This is a vintage postcard written in Hungarian. The left side contains a handwritten message, while the right side is formatted for the recipient's address. There is a pink postage stamp labeled 'MAGYARORSZÁG' (Hungary) with a value of 8 fillér, depicting the Holy Crown of Hungary. The address is written to 'Molnár Sarika' in Budapest. The bottom margin credits the publisher: 'Barasits János Budapest.'
